runsheet.short_description: Opening plenary (A6-008, hybrid): run the online topic vote on Dotstorming and take the top 4 topics.
During the plenary and the reconvene, bring the mic to on-site participants who speak.
During the plenary, promote the online hosts to co-host in the hub, so they can move between breakout rooms later. Do not open breakout rooms yet.

Run an on-site vote among the top 4 to select 2 on-site topics. Announce each topic with its room and host: the 2 on-site topics (A6-008, A6-007), and the remaining 2 topics online, each with an online host.
Create 2 breakout rooms named after the online topics. Open the breakout rooms, allowing participants to choose their room.
Screenshare this notice (in More Info) in the hub. Press 'pause' in the Zoom top bar to freeze the screenshare.
Go to your assigned on-site room or online breakout room. Hosts facilitate ~45 min of discussion and have the group pick a presenter for the reconvene.
Broadcast a 5-minute warning to all breakout rooms; then close the breakout rooms so everyone returns to the hub.
On-site in A6-007: bring the group back to A6-008.
Reconnect A6-008 to the Zoom hub.
Invite each group's presenter to share conclusions: 2 online conclusions and 2 on-site conclusions.
Close the session for everyone, on-site and online.
